limitations: Document-level coverage does not establish passage relevance or claim entailment.
Offline replay assesses fixed candidate pools; it does not evaluate new retrieval or generation.
Prefix-protection variants are in-sample experiments on the same 35 scored questions; independent holdout is required.
Q29 abstention behavior and governance authority resolution are not validated.
